name: Gradient Slopes
description: Every measure's decile gradient on one chart, normalized so the reference decile equals 1.0 on a log scale - the slope IS the inequality, and a line ending at 2.5x means the top decile carries 2.5 times the burden of the bottom one. Collision-relaxed right-edge labels replace a legend, and hovering a line or its label isolates that measure. The one-chart summary companion to per-measure gradient lines.
